name_zh: 装修报价单增项防守助手
desc_zh: 拆解装修报价单的五要素，标出按实结算与品牌不明的活口条款，算清增项风险并给出议价话术与合同条款补充建议
desc_en: Use when the user asks to review a renovation quotation, worries about surprise add-on charges, or wants to know which line items are too vague. Breaks the quotation into six checkable elements, flags open-ended items such as settle-actual pricing or unspecified brands, estimates a rough add-on risk range, and produces negotiation scripts plus reference contract clauses to paste in. Does not appraise construction cost or give legal advice.
